scope: Raft 0.6 single design system; modes light/dark/system. Semantic recipes are owned by the pinned official package.

families.rule: Use native size/variant/state recipes. Defined defaults are allowed; unexplained page overrides are not.
Local detail dismissal uses the official component, preserving navigation and unresolved-write guards. Loading/error branches follow the same rule.
Keep container focus return, Escape and dismissal fences. Do not replace with generic detail close.

families.owner: official PickerTriggerButton or the source toolbar's Button parameters
families.rule: Reuse the owning toolbar recipe, not a form-field selector. Task and memory filter adaptation does not redefine all filter sizes.

families.owner: official FieldSelectTrigger and raft-ui form primitives
families.rule: Use the field family with its labels, validation and disabled state; no toolbar-sized substitutions.
Preserve hover/touch disclosure, disabled/pending semantics and composer event rules. Do not bulk-convert ghost to outline.

families.owner: official sidebar / segmented / tree / disclosure components
families.rule: Native HTML buttons are allowed when structurally ported from the matching source. A row or back arrow is not a submit or X-close action.

families.owner: official dialog/action primitives and feature authorization
families.rule: Variant conveys priority; preserve existing confirmation, revision and unknown-result handling. Do not infer business rules from a button label.

families.owner: raft-ui PanelAction within official Agent profile header
families.rule: Only the registered instance profile close uses native PanelAction; desktop action hidden below md, mobile uses native back. No size/variant override. Preserve Escape, opener focus and unknown-write guards.
families.sourceRevision: v1.21.22 af3d6ef4a22f0f05f5f9db9424285755d67e9726 / AgentDetailPanel-B3FrpUPj.js il; page-adoption instance-inspector-chrome

families.rule: Native comment toggle icon-lg ghost/outline and desktop sidebar/mobile sheet; Loom binds existing attachment comment owner. Published PDF permits whole-file discussion only, forces null anchors and displays scope. Cross-origin viewer unchanged; no page/selection annotations.

exceptions.owner: owner-approved compact mobile adaptation, preserved by AGENTS.md
exceptions.rule: Retain owner-approved compact headers and composer layout; rUI 0.6 owns icon geometry and hit area. Mobile primary pages use PanelSectionHeader and its layer-frame/on-frame tokens; detail headers use PanelHeader. Root title and trailing text count use the 16px content edges, not centered groups or trailing icon overhang. Do not reintroduce the old custom close pseudo-element.
Memory filter buttons adopt current task-toolbar parameters; this is not a global replacement of PickerTriggerButton or form fields.

exceptions.owner: official task mobile full-screen navigation; retained Loom task presentation
exceptions.rule: The mobile control labelled close is a back arrow; preserve its Button outline and navigation semantics rather than replacing with an X.

limits: Bindings identify ownership and review scope; listing a file is not visual acceptance.

Guards enforce local detail closures, registered action provenance, absence of per-action size/variant overrides and mobile selector semantics; they do not prove every control in every theme conforms.
Frozen upstream components retain their own contracts. Changing their DOM adaptation requires a scoped integration check.

formSave.rule: Full configuration form submit, md accent.
formSave.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page

formCancel.rule: Full configuration form cancel, md outline.
formCancel.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page

dialogSave.rule: Compact creation or selection footer, md accent.
dialogSave.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page

confirmDelete.rule: Destructive confirmation, native default md danger.
confirmDelete.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page

confirmChange.rule: Explicit disruptive change confirmation, md warning variant.
confirmChange.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page

recovery.rule: SearchResultsBoundaryFallback retry, md outline; same role for Loom receipt verification.
recovery.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page

secondary.rule: Secondary compact dialog/content action, native md outline.
secondary.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page

menuIcon.rule: Icon-only menu uses native icon-md recipe; preserve existing ghost interaction.
menuIcon.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page
